summary: PS Canada Finance ULC, a Public Storage subsidiary, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for C$400,000,000 of 4.540% senior notes due September 16, 2033, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Public Storage and Public Storage Operating Company. Notes priced at 100.000% of par with a 0.370% underwriting discount, yielding C$398,520,000 before expenses; interest payable semi-annually each March 16 and September 16 starting March 16, 2027. Settlement is expected September 16, 2026, through CDS book-entry, sold privately in Canada to accredited investors and permitted clients. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
